    Evaluation of linear paths and its first-order deformation, over any ring #

    Given modules N_X over a commutative ring R and maps φ_a : N_y → N_x for the arrows of a translation quiver, a path evaluates to the composite of the arrow maps (evP), extended linearly to RQ (evL). Arrow corrections g_a give the ε-part δ of the evaluation of φ + εg (δp, δL), a derivation (δL_comp). When the mesh relations hold for φ (evL_ideal), and also to first order (δL_ideal), both kill the mesh ideal.

    This is the ring-generic part of the proof of Proposition 7.6 (PsiInjective), used over ℤ/4 for Lemma 10.2 (integral-deformations.tex).
